newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte nominates slate to Rexene.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte nominates slate to Rexene.

text.p: Investor Guy Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said on Wednesday they have nominated four people to take control of Rexene Corp's board of directors.
Wyser-Pratte owns 953,600 shares of Rexene, representing 5.07 percent of the company's stock, while Spear, Leeds & Kellog own 948,600 shares, they said in a statement.
The nominees, if Rexene shareholders adopt a proposal to call a special meeting to replace the board, are Lawrence McQuade, James Pasman Jr., Robert Mauch and Jonahan Macey, Recene said.
Rexene rejected a $16 a share takeover bid from Huntsman Corp, according to a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing.
Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg had said in past filings that the rejection of a $15-a-share bid from Huntsman was not in the best interests of shareholders, Rexene said.
Wyser-Pratte and Spear, Leeds & Kellogg are seeking to reduce the number of board members so their slate would constitute a majority on the board.
Wyser-Pratte said in a statement that three of the nominees have chemical industry experience, while Macey is a lawyer with expertise on corporate governance.

"These four individuals have been charged with maximizing the current value of Rexene shares by selling the company," Wyser-Pratte said in a statement. "Should that not be possible, however, these seasoned executives are clearly qualified to lead Rexene for the long term."
Rexene was not immediately available for comment.
